event.name: Stablecoin Founder Panel
event.topic: How stablecoins are changing consumer payments

speaker.name: Avery Chen
speaker.bio: Founder building consumer wallet infrastructure for stablecoin payments.

prep_doc_payload.title: Stablecoin Founder Panel - Avery Chen Prep

panel_questions.question: What did you learn about consumer payments that was not obvious before you started building Northstar Wallet?
panel_questions.why_it_works: Grounds the panel in founder-specific learning instead of generic stablecoin commentary.

panel_questions.question: Where are stablecoins already good enough for consumers, and where do they still feel like infrastructure instead of product?
panel_questions.why_it_works: Separates real product readiness from industry optimism.

panel_questions.question: What has to be invisible for a consumer wallet to feel trustworthy?
panel_questions.why_it_works: Connects UX, safety, and infrastructure without asking for confidential roadmap details.

panel_questions.question: How do you think about distribution when the end user may not care that the payment rail is a stablecoin?
panel_questions.why_it_works: Moves beyond technology into go-to-market and adoption.

panel_questions.question: What is one misconception founders have when they first try to build payments products on crypto rails?
panel_questions.why_it_works: Creates a useful builder takeaway for the VCW audience.

panel_questions.question: If we reran this panel in two years, what would need to change for stablecoins to feel normal in everyday commerce?
panel_questions.why_it_works: Ends with a forward-looking, concrete adoption bar.
